lines.en: I walk by the smell of monsters.

lines.zh: 我的大脚掌踩得地板直颤。
lines.en: My broad feet make the floor shake.

lines.zh: 我提着麦克风，慢慢过去。
lines.en: I carry my microphone and move on.

lines.zh: 我的黄色绒毛在暗处很好认。
lines.en: My yellow fur shows up well in the dark.

lines.zh: 我一步一步靠近那个影子。
lines.en: I close on that shadow step by step.
I turn the corner without pausing.
My hat scrapes the doorframe.
I squeeze between the tables.
I know where they hide.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，不像要找麻烦。
lines.en: I walk steadily, like I'm not after trouble.

lines.zh: 我的步子不快，但一直往前。
lines.en: My pace isn't quick, but it doesn't stop.

lines.zh: 我在地毯上留下浅浅的印。
lines.en: I leave faint marks on the rug.

lines.zh: 我站着，把麦克风换了手。
lines.en: I stand and shift the microphone to my other hand.
My bowtie is a bit crooked.
I raise my head and listen about.
Fine dust sits in my fur.
I'm waiting for a monster to stir.
I straighten my hat.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛亮得不太自然。
lines.en: My eyes glow in a way that isn't natural.
I don't sit; I never sit.
The room is too quiet. I don't like it.
I only raise a hand to monsters.
You don't have that smell on you.
You're on my right; don't block me.
You can see me. Good.
I didn't come for you.
Your light has found me.

lines.zh: 你听见那边的声音了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear that, over there?
Step aside; I'm passing.
I know the living from the haunted.
There's something behind you; I know.
A bit of iron shows through my fur.
I have not given a single step.
My eyes dim for an instant.
This doesn't change anything.
I brush it off and keep going.
Dust covers me all over.
I'll remember that one.
That blow did not even chip my paint.
I only hunt monsters, not you.
I see you holding it up.
There's nothing in there.
Keep that for yourself.

lines.zh: 我要找的东西不长这样。
lines.en: What I'm hunting doesn't look like that.
Don't try to stop me with that.
I still have to get over there.

lines.zh: 你举着什么？我只对怪物有兴趣。
lines.en: What are you holding up? Monsters interest me, not you.
You bump me and I stand like a fixture.
You step back; I haven't moved.
My fur is thick, and not very soft.
You've touched my bowtie.
I shift past your side.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我们都不太舒服。
lines.en: Neither of us liked that.

lines.zh: 你挡住了我要去的地方。
lines.en: You're blocking where I'm going.
I pause, then go around.
Dust falls between us.
Don't shoulder me.
A few of us patrol here in turns.
It's the white one.
We never walk side by side.
It holds the back room; I hold the hall.
I hear its footsteps.
It's much older than I am.

lines.zh: 我们各自站着，各看一边。
lines.en: We stand apart, each watching one side.
It can only watch; I can act.
At daylight neither of us makes a sound.
This bit of wire still works.
I wrap it around my wrist.
There's a scrap of cloth on the floor.
As I bend, my hat slips.
I pick it up and pocket it.
This has blood on it.
I gather the parts into one pile.
I pick things up carefully; my hands are clumsy.
A gear rolls across the floor.
I catch it under my foot.
I see the monster over there.
My eyes flare.
It isn't human. That makes this simple.
I move the microphone to my left hand.
It poked out from behind the cabinet.
Locked on, in the corner.
It doesn't know I'm here.
My feet have already turned that way.
Its shadow is trembling.
I won't hesitate.
They won't come back tonight.
I'll shut the door first.
It's running for the rear hall.
I'm blocking that way.
I follow it into the hall.
Its claws scrape the wall.
Twenty a blow, and I only hunt monsters.
It's hidden in the storeroom.
I crack the door open.
It won't come out.
I wait for it to move.

lines.zh: 我的头一直朝它的方向。
lines.en: My head stays turned its way.
It's moved to another corner.

lines.zh: 我听见那只怪物的呼吸了。
lines.en: I hear that monster breathing.

lines.zh: 这屋里没有第二个出口。
lines.en: This room has no second exit.
I've backed it to the wall.
It's starting to retreat.
I don't chase fast; I chase true.

lines.zh: 它的影子贴在墙上不动了。
lines.en: Its shadow has stopped on the wall.
Three steps, and I am counting.
It has raised its claws.

lines.zh: 帽子压低，我走向那个角落
lines.en: Hat low, I walk toward that corner
I herd it into the corner.
It ran for the door.
I drive one palm down on its head.
It's flung against the table leg.
My fist carries weight.
It tried to bite me and missed.
I seize its arm and twist.
Its bones crack.
A gash opens in my fur.
It backs up; I press in.
It can't get up anymore.
I throw it out into the hall.
I shake the dust off my hand.
I leave the stain on the floor.
It has gone completely still.
I turn slowly back.
As long as the music plays, we're fine.
It is pressed down on the rug.
My palm carries a lot of weight.
It scratched me once.
I stand in the middle of the hall.

lines.zh: 舞台的灯把我照得很亮。
lines.en: The stage light shines right on me.
I adjust my bowtie.
Tonight it's my turn to patrol.

lines.zh: 我的绒毛还带着旧糖浆的味道。
lines.en: My fur still smells of old syrup.

lines.zh: 这里的东西都还在原处。
lines.en: Everything here is still in its place.
I lift the microphone once.
There's a sound from the lobby.
I step out from behind the table.
No one has to wake me.
I settle and start listening.
My fur catches fire; I smother it first.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上滚下去，摔得很闷。
lines.en: I roll down the stairs with a heavy thud.

lines.zh: 水浸进布和绒里，我沉了。
lines.en: Water soaks my cloth and fur, and I sink.
The blast slams me into the wall.
The light is too bright for my eyes.
I don't eat, yet I've gotten slow.

lines.zh: 雷劈到我，我的动作乱了。
lines.en: Lightning hits and my movements scramble.
